messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Bundle apps for local install
parts:
Hello,

How may we bundle a shiny app with R and the shiny package for convenient download and installation by non R users? We need a user (that does not know or use R) to be able to click on a web link. In response an installer downloads and installs everything they need to run the R Shiny app, relatively seamlessly. Kind of like we would do if we wrote an app in visual basic.

It's not good enough to just put all the ui.R and server.R code into one larger .R file (I've seen examples of this), and send it to them. They do not have R installed and walking every potential user through installing R and the packages is a barrier to adaptation. We really need it self contained. One last reason to do it this way, is to control the version of R and shiny that is used to run the app, by bundling R and shiny with the app.

Jonathan
